display_long_description:
NOCTURNE

A hardboiled rhythm shooter about the most dangerous job in the city: popping balloons.

You ride forward through a dark, cinematic corridor, a pistol in each hand. Out of the shadows drift glowing balloons — and your only job is to pop them in time with the beat. It's fast, it's stylish, and (for the record) nobody gets hurt. They're balloons.

HOW IT PLAYS
- Aim with each hand and fire your twin pistols at incoming balloons.
- Shoot ON THE BEAT to build combos and multiply your score.
- Every color is worth a different amount — common whites up to rare golds.
- Miss one and it floats away into the night, gone for good.
- Watch for the hidden BLACK balloon: nearly invisible, worth a fortune.
- Each shot whistles a musical note — keep firing and your guns perform a full classical melody.

MADE FOR VR
Your two Meta Quest controllers become the twin pistols — point with your own hands and pop. You move forward automatically at a smooth, constant speed with no artificial camera turns, for a comfortable ride. Designed to be played standing, with room to turn and aim.

STYLE
Black corridors, pools of red light, film grain and cinematic bars — a whole film-noir mood, poured into a game about popping balloons.

NOCTURNE — Pop. Perform. End the night.
